facts.text: The Bobcat Promise covers tuition and mandatory fees up to 15 hours per semester for eligible students through federal, state, and university funding.

facts.text: The Bobcat Promise covers tuition and mandatory fees up to 15 credit hours per semester for new entering freshmen with a FAFSA income of $50,000 or less.
